accuracy_note: The conversion factor is configurable and stored with every measurement.
advanced_statistics_hint: Scientific-quality diagnostics, uncertainty estimates, threshold-event summaries and sensitivity analyses for in-depth evaluation.
analysis_hint: Select period, room and campaign. All metrics are calculated only from the filtered hourly records.
analysis_limited: The analysis has limited reliability because the measurement period is short or hours are missing.
analysis_summary_no_data: No analysable measurements are available for the selected context.
analysis_trend_falling: The series shows a downward tendency.
analysis_trend_rising: The series shows an upward tendency.
app_subtitle: Local monitoring for GQ RadonScan devices
architecture: Data path: USB/SPIR → SQLite → MQTT/Home Assistant.
assignment_end_after_start: The end must be after the start.
assignment_requires_room: Create at least one room first. The assignment form will then be enabled.
assignment_step_hint: Then assign a device and time period to the saved room.
assignment_title_required: Enter a title for the measurement assignment.
basic_statistics_hint: Key metrics for a quick technical assessment of the selected period.
block_bootstrap: Block bootstrap accounting for temporal dependence
chart_empty: There is not enough data for this chart yet.
completed_note: The app publishes only completed hourly values stored by the device.
concentration_level_hint: Central tendency, rolling averages and peak levels for the selected period.
configuration_only: Can only be changed in App configuration
confirm_delete_entire_database: Permanently delete the complete local Radon Monitoring database? This cannot be undone.
confirm_delete_map: Delete this floor plan? Rooms will be retained but detached from the map.
confirm_delete_site: Delete this room? Assigned measurements will be retained and detached from the room.
confirm_destructive_action: Perform this destructive action? Check the period and selection carefully.
confirm_ha_purge: Purge Home Assistant Recorder history for the selected entities?
confirm_purge_all_radonscan: Permanently delete all Home Assistant history for every detected RadonScan entity?
confirm_restore: Replace the current local database with this backup?
connection_error: The device could not be read.
data_hint: Back up, export, restore or delete the complete local database. Write actions require explicit confirmation and are logged.
data_quality_hint_extended: Coverage, sampling rhythm and data gaps determine how reliable the statistics are.
delete_database_complete_hint: This permanently removes all local measurements, devices, campaigns, rooms, events, reports, calibrations, factor history, World Map queues and administration logs. The empty database schema remains available.
delete_local_hint: A backup is created automatically before deletion. The history inside the physical RadonScan device remains unchanged.
development_and_comparison_hint: Trend indicators and direct comparison with the immediately preceding period of equal length.
device_error_no_ports: No eligible serial ports were found.
device_error_no_response: The port opened, but the device did not respond to GETVER.
device_error_not_detected: Automatic discovery did not identify a RadonScan.
device_error_permission_denied: Permission to open the serial port was denied.
device_error_port_busy: The serial port is already in use by another service.
device_error_port_not_found: The configured serial port does not exist.
device_error_read_error: The serial port could not be read reliably.
device_error_wrong_device: A different serial device responded on this port, not a RadonScan.
distribution_and_variability_hint: Percentiles and robust spread measures show how wide the values are distributed.
event_impact_hint: Exploratory effect estimates for documented events based on values before and after the event.
event_impact_note: Evaluated from the first event in the selected period:
event_impact_unavailable: No event windows with sufficient measurements before and after the event are available in the selected period.
event_time_required: Enter a time for the event.
event_title_required: Enter a title for the event.
experimental_notice: The hourly decoder is supported by measurement series but is not an official GQ specification.
gmcmap_config_hint: Account ID and Device ID are configured in the Home Assistant app options.
gmcmap_hint: Optionally publish the latest completed radon reading to the public GQ GMCMap radon map.
gmcmap_privacy_1: When enabled, the radon value and the identifiers assigned by GMCMap leave the local Home Assistant system.
gmcmap_privacy_2: The public location is managed in the GMCMap device profile. This app does not transmit GPS coordinates.
gmcmap_protocol_note: Uploads use GMCMap's documented public log2.asp endpoint with AID, GID and pCi only. No CPM, ACPM or uSV field is sent.
gmcmap_ready_notice: The integration is configured. Manual and, when enabled, automatic uploads are available.
gmcmap_setup_notice: Enable the integration and enter GMCMap Account ID and Device ID in the app configuration, then restart the app.
ha_location_privacy: The location data comes from the general Home Assistant settings and is not sent to an external geocoding service.
ha_location_unavailable: Location data is not available in Home Assistant.
ha_purge_all_hint: Deletes the complete Home Assistant Recorder history of all RadonScan and Radon Monitoring entities. Individual selection has been removed. Name patterns also cover entities that no longer exist but still have stored history. Local app data remains unchanged.
ha_purge_async_note: Accepted by Home Assistant; physical recorder database cleanup may continue in the background.
ha_purge_hint: Removes Recorder data only for the selected entities. Local Radon Monitoring data and device history remain unchanged.
ha_purge_history_remaining: History is still present or cleanup is still running.
ha_purge_ready: Ready. Enter PURGE or DELETE to start.
ha_purge_running: Sending the purge request to Home Assistant …
ha_purge_started: Home Assistant accepted the purge request.
ha_purge_verified: No older history was found for the checked entities.
ha_room_source_hint: Place or address and building are taken directly from the general Home Assistant settings and cannot be edited here.
heatmap_hint: Mean by weekday and hour; cells with insufficient data remain empty.
history_empty: The history table appears after the first imported hourly value.
manual_note_v3: The user manual matches version 5.5.14. The separate SPIR protocol reference remains version 3.0.0 because it describes the device protocol, not the app release.
manual_upload_hint: Uploads only the latest completed local hourly reading. Historical timestamps cannot be sent by the published protocol.
map_click_hint: Click the floor plan to set the room position.
map_hint: Upload a local floor plan, place rooms and assign measurement periods. Files never leave the system.
measurement_assignments_hint: Time-based assignments of devices, rooms and measurement campaigns.
measurement_height_help: Optional height of the device above the floor in metres.
measurement_height_number: Measurement height must be a number.
measurement_height_range: Measurement height must be between 0 and 10 m.
name: Name
no_assignments: No measurement assignments have been created yet.
no_data: No completed hour is available yet.
no_ha_entities: No matching Radon Monitoring entities were found.
no_map: No floor plan is available yet.
no_sites: No rooms have been created yet.
no_sites_next_step: No rooms have been created yet. Enter a room above; the measurement assignment will then be enabled.
overview_selection_hint: Device and campaign determine the displayed values. The currently assigned room is selected automatically and shown below the Home Assistant location.
period_not_reached: The required measurement period has not yet been reached.
radon_traffic_hint: The classification uses the warning and danger thresholds configured in Settings.
radon_traffic_unavailable: No current measurement is available yet.
read_only_notice: The device is accessed exclusively with GET and SPIR read commands.
report_item_charts: time series, distribution and temporal patterns
report_item_checksum: SHA-256 checksum of the PDF file
reports_hint: Create traceable PDF reports with statistics, data quality, charts, events, room, Home Assistant location and checksum.
restore_hint: Accepts an SQLite database or a ZIP archive produced by Radon Monitoring. A backup is created automatically before replacement.
room_already_exists: A room with this name already exists.
room_field_help: Example: study, basement or bedroom. Place and building come automatically from Home Assistant.
room_form_hint: Only the room and measurement height are entered manually.
room_name_invalid: The room name contains invalid control characters.
room_name_too_long: The room name may contain at most 120 characters.
room_save_not_confirmed: The server did not confirm that the room was saved.
rooms_list_hint: Saved rooms with measurement height and most recently assigned measurements.
scientific_limit_notice: Short-term values and statistical associations are not regulatory, medical or building-engineering assessments. A statutory annual reference value should only be compared with a sufficiently long and representative measurement period.
scientific_notice: Uncertainty covers counting statistics only. It does not include calibration or other systematic effects. Change points are exploratory indications, not proof of causation.
security_note: Sensitive values are never exposed in the interface or diagnostic exports.
selected_room_missing: The selected room no longer exists.
self_test_not_run: The self-test has not been run yet.
settings_hint: Change these values in Home Assistant under App configuration.
sites_events_hint: Manage rooms, measurement campaigns, time-based assignments and documented events locally.
sites_without_floorplan_hint: Rooms remain available as local metadata. Location and building details come directly from Home Assistant.
system_self_test_hint: Checks the database, room storage path, report directory and device, MQTT and Home Assistant connections without changing measurement data.
thresholds_and_exceedances_hint: Time shares above the warning and danger thresholds plus contiguous exceedance phases.
title: Title
uncertainty_unavailable: Not calculable from available raw counts
verify_purge_hint: After a short wait, checks the Home Assistant History API for older Recorder entries belonging to currently known RadonScan entities.
